summary: the meal randomizer spec (§10, §6.1) treats the recipes box's existing tests as the safety net for the DetailPane/provider refactor, but that suite does not exist: services/web/src/routes/ has zero test files and no component test renders DetailPane, RecipeLedger or the recipes layout
evidence: find services/web/src/routes -name '*.test.ts*' returns nothing; the only component tests are useWindowedRows.test.ts, plan/optimistic.test.ts, grocery/optimistic.test.ts, collections/optimistic.test.ts and collections/scope.test.ts, none of which render a component; @testing-library/react is a devDependency with zero render() call sites in the repo

summary: Randomizer page gains a phantom document scroll (~200-430px): the whole app shell scrolls up, the sticky controls scroll off screen and the recipe body is cut mid-column with dead space below
evidence: Playwright at 1280x720 on /household/randomizer after a roll: document.documentElement.scrollHeight=924 vs clientHeight=720; window.scrollTo(0,4000) moves window.scrollY to 204 and the screenshot shows the controls region gone, the recipe title clipped by the fixed header, 'Ingredients' cut off and ~200px of empty background. Cause: RecipeTagStrip's Tailwind .sr-only spans are position:absolute and the nearest positioned ancestor is the layout div OUTSIDE <main> (main is overflow-hidden but does not create a containing block), so they escape the clip and extend the document. Proof: setting position:relative on the result scroll container drops documentElement.scrollHeight from 924 to 720. /household/recipes/$id does not exhibit it (scrollHeight 720).

summary: readRandomizerPool's corpus branch (source:'corpus') never checks membership — the `did` argument is unused on that path, so a non-member of the household gets a full corpus pool, facets, and aggregates derived from that household's private box and meal plan
evidence: Probe in randomizer.db.test.ts: readRandomizerPool(db, DID_B, HH_A, {source:'corpus'}) where DID_B is a member of HH_B only → pool.pool.length=47, totalInScope=47, facets.cuisines=12, and the anti-join 'not exists (household_recipe hr2 ... hr2.household_id=HH_A)' silently reveals which public recipes HH_A has boxed (R_CORPUS_BOXED was excluded). The box branch fails closed correctly (totalInScope=0) because householdScopedQuery joins membership; the corpus branch has no such join. Plan §3: 'Authorization is the same chokepoint every box query uses'; §10 requires 'non-member ... fail closed'.

summary: Two of the 37 randomizer db tests are vacuous — they pass unchanged when the behaviour they name is deliberately broken
evidence: Mutation 1: deleted "and l.verdict in ('contains','may_contain')" from the allergen facet aggregate in server/randomizer.ts. Test 'allergens: only contains/may_contain verdicts contribute — not_detected and unknown do not' STILL PASSED (45/45 green) — the fixture's only not_detected/unknown allergen rows use slug 'peanut', which is already present via a 'contains' row, so dropping the verdict filter changes nothing observable. Mutation 2: replaced orderedOptions' canonical filter with [...present].sort(). Test 'mealTypes: canonical order, not alphabetical' STILL PASSED — the fixture only carries breakfast+dinner, and 'breakfast' < 'dinner' alphabetically too, so canonical and alphabetical agree; the test's own comment ('breakfast sorts after dinner alphabetically') is false. Only the spiceLevels test caught mutation 2. Separately, 'diets: EXCLUDES gluten_free and dairy_free' asserts only gluten_free — no fixture recipe carries dairy_free at all.

summary: Randomizer sheet section headings render UPPERCASE (DIETS, AVOID…, SPICE LEVEL, COLLECTION) — the brand is sentence case for headings, buttons, labels and badges
evidence: Playwright: opening 'More filters' at 1280x720, the dialog innerText reads 'DIETS / AVOID… / SPICE LEVEL / COLLECTION'. Source: RandomizerFiltersSheet.tsx applies 'text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.03em] uppercase' to all four.

summary: A SET filter chip is painted with the primary/destructive red, identical to the 'What should I make?' CTA beside it, so a state reads as a call to action; and a set single-select chip has no set treatment at all
evidence: Playwright getComputedStyle at 1280x720: the pressed 'Skipping the last 14 days' chip has background rgb(226,35,26) and the primary roll button has background rgb(226,35,26) — the same crocker red. Unset chips are rgb(255,253,244). SingleSelectChip renders variant=outline with no set-state class, so 'Dinner' and 'Any meal' are visually identical apart from the word. Comp/brand: a set chip uses --accent (#ffe9a0, butter-pale).

summary: The three single-select filter chips have no accessible name for the dimension they filter — a set chip announces only its value ('Dinner', 'Italian', 'Under 30 min')
evidence: Playwright tab walk of /household/randomizer: accessible names are 'Any meal', 'Any time', 'Any cuisine'; the 'label' prop (Meal type / Max time / Cuisine) is used only in the disabled-state title attribute. With a value set the trigger reads as a bare value with no dimension.

summary: The §5.6 staleness marker ('Doesn't match your current filters') is never announced to assistive tech — it appears and disappears outside any live region
evidence: Browser-verified §5.6: toggling Favourites on left the drawn recipe on screen and rendered the stale marker; the only aria-live region on the surface is the pool-count paragraph, and the marker is a plain sibling span with no role/status. A screen-reader user hears the new pool count but is never told the result below no longer matches.

summary: A corpus (public-network) draw can render a raw ISO-8601 duration as its time: 'Red Thai Coconut Chicken Soup - Peanut variation · PT0S'
evidence: Playwright: widening to public recipes with ingredient 'lemongrass' drew that recipe and the meta row read '· PT0S'. Cause: recipeViewDataFromDetail passes detail.totalTime through formatDuration, which returns the input unchanged when the duration parses to <= 0 seconds (lib/format.ts:31). routes/recipes.$id.tsx:351 has the same pre-existing shape.

summary: §7.2 violation: RandomizerBoxResult's LightweightCard copies DetailPane's markup — the page container, the display-title heading, the meta row and the 4:3 image box are verbatim class-string copies
evidence: Diff-read: LightweightCard uses 'mx-auto flex max-w-[54rem] flex-col gap-3.5 px-5 pt-4 pb-8' (DetailPane.tsx:234), 'display-title m-0 text-[1.625rem] leading-[1.1] text-balance text-foreground' (DetailPane.tsx:254), 'flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-[0.75rem] font-semibold text-muted-foreground' (DetailPane.tsx:256) and the image box 'relative aspect-[4/3] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border-2 border-border bg-muted' + 'absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover' + 'grid size-full place-content-center' + UtensilsCrossed size-10 (DetailPane.tsx:367-376). §7.2 forbids copying a heading, a meta row or an image slot out of DetailPane outright.

summary: The skip-recent window is spelled two ways on one screen and one spelling is a literal that will silently lie: the pool line says 'from the last 2 weeks' while the chip says 'Skipping the last 14 days', and 14 is hardcoded in three places
evidence: Browser: pool line 'Rolling from 196 recipes · skipping 2 from the last 2 weeks' next to chip 'Skipping the last 14 days'. Source: poolLineText hardcodes '2 weeks' (household.randomizer.tsx:103); RandomizerFilterBar hardcodes 14 in both the label and onChange({skipRecentDays: on ? 14 : null}); defaultFilters() has its own 14.

summary: the corpus anti-join's per-household scope and the diet filter's verdict='likely' requirement were both unguarded — deliberately breaking either left all 43 tests green
evidence: Mutation M9: 'hr2.recipe_id = r.id and hr2.household_id = $householdId' -> 'hr2.recipe_id = r.id' in the §4.5 anti-join (i.e. 'in ANY box' instead of 'in THIS box') — 43/43 still passed. The fixture's only anti-join subject, R_CORPUS_BOXED, was boxed by HH_A, so global and per-household anti-joins agreed. Mutation M13: labelExistsWhere(sql,'diet',slug,'likely') -> verdict null (match any verdict) — 43/43 still passed; every diet label in the fixture was already 'likely', so the 'excluded' verdict (a real value per migration 1787679680100's check constraint, and the OPPOSITE of a match) was never exercised. Both now killed by new tests plus two fixture rows (R_CORPUS_OTHERBOX boxed by HH_B only; R_VEGAN_EXCLUDED carrying diet/vegan=excluded).

summary: Picking a value in a single-select filter chip leaves its dropdown menu open over the results — Base UI's Menu.RadioItem defaults to closeOnClick={false}
evidence: Playwright: after clicking the 'Dinner' menuitemradio in the Meal type chip, document.querySelectorAll('[role=menu]').length is 1 and the trigger's aria-expanded is still 'true'; a subsequent click on 'More filters' is intercepted by Base UI's inert backdrop until Escape is pressed. A single-select filter has nothing more to pick, so the menu is just covering the pool line and result it just changed.

summary: The §4.3 coverage line calls public-network recipes 'your recipes' when the pool has been widened to the corpus — 'No recipes match these filters / 3 of your 44 recipes are still being tagged' with source=corpus
evidence: Playwright: filtered to ingredient 'lemongrass' (box pool 0), widened to public recipes, kept the single result — the corpus pool went 1 to 0 and the empty state in the controls region rendered '3 of your 44 recipes are still being tagged, so a diet or meal-type filter can't see them yet.' The 44 are public recipes the household has NOT kept; none of them are the reader's. Screenshot r-kept-1280.png.

summary: Widening to a corpus pool that turns out to be empty CLEARS the drawn recipe off screen, violating §5.6's 'nothing vanishes out from under someone mid-read'
evidence: Playwright: with a drawn box result on screen, typing an ingredient that matches nothing (box pool 0, result correctly stayed and was marked stale), then pressing 'Look in public recipes' — the corpus pool is also 0 and the result region blanked back to the empty state, with the roll button relabelled 'What should I make?'. Cause: performRoll() in routes/household.randomizer.tsx calls setDrawn(null) on both its empty branches; onRoll cannot reach them (the button is disabled at pool size 0) so onWidenToCorpus is the only caller that can, and it does.
